_comment: The code pack as data: swap this file and the vocabulary changes, no code edit. Concepts and predicates get their owning pack name from CodePack, so a fork of this file under another pack name does not contest these keys (FR-025).

concepts.label: function
concepts.definition: A named callable defined in source code, including methods.

concepts.label: class
concepts.definition: A named type defined in source code, holding methods and attributes.

concepts.label: module
concepts.definition: An importable unit of source code, named by its dotted import path.

concepts.label: file
concepts.definition: A source file on disk, named by its path within the repository.

predicates.label: calls
predicates.definition: The subject's body invokes the object callable.

predicates.label: imports
predicates.definition: The subject brings the object module into its namespace.

predicates.label: defines
predicates.definition: The object symbol is declared inside the subject.

predicates.label: tests
predicates.definition: The subject is a test exercising the object callable.
